BR 101 Expert

Cab setup

  • Machine room first: cut-off valves open, LSS 44F01 set (page 2)
  • Fahrschalter at Off; PARK BRK up: reverser key in, brake key unlocked (held while up)
  • Richtungsschalter to Neutral, wait for the screens; pantograph up, Hauptschalter in
  • Brake preparation, SiFa and PZB on (aux squares), tests (page 2)
  • Train data on the ZDE panel; lights to Signal lights or Headlights
  • Forward, ZS train supply on, doors (RUD TRIM); AFB on in the cab

Cleared to depart

  • Close doors, check the signal and PZB
  • Parking brake off on the back wall (needs 1.5 bar C-pressure)
  • Führerbremsventil to Running, release the direct brake
  • Fahrschalter towards Z, or set the AFB speed on the flap lever
  • Acknowledge SiFa with the gear lever, PZB with the ENG switches
  • Brake: Führerbremsventil towards SB in steps

BR 101 Expert Aufrüsten: from cold to departure

A cold-start service finds the BR 101 dark with the parking brake on; a timetable service loads it with the cab unoccupied, SiFa isolated and the LZB/PZB breaker open. On a loco that is already powered, start at step 8.

Back wall and machine room

  1. 1Cab 1 back wall Loco under the wire; parking brake light (Federspeicher anlegen) on.
  2. 2Cab 1 back wall Battery (Batterie) ON; the voltage must read above 95 V.
  3. 3Cab 1 back wall Pantograph selector to Auto (or the one you want); every LSS breaker on this wall set.
  4. 4valve cabinet Open the SIFA and the red PZB/LZB cut-off valves; all others open except drain, towing, bypass and relay.
  5. 5breakers by Cab 2 Set every breaker, including LSS 44F01 LZB/PZB-Hauptschalter in the third row.
  6. 6machine room Auxiliary reservoir under 7 bar: close LSS 34F05 (auxiliary compressor); if it will not run, drain below 4.8 bar first.
  7. 7Leave the machine room before raising the pantograph: entering it with the Hauptschalter closed is prohibited.

Occupy Cab 1 and power up

  1. 8Sit down; Fahrschalter (power handle) at Off, or the reverser will not move. Left throttle
  2. 9Reverser key in and brake key unlocked; keep PARK BRK up, the key is held only while it is. PARK BRK
  3. 10Richtungsschalter from Off to Neutral; wait for the screens to boot (over a minute). Speedbrake lever
  4. 11desk Raise the pantograph (SA heben), close the Hauptschalter (HS ein). 'Druckluft HS zu gering' = under 7 bar.
  5. 12left screen Press [St] and check for faults.
  6. 13Lights as required; off on an end coupled to a coach. AUTO BRK

Brake system preparation

  1. 14back wall NBÜ/ep switch to 0 in both cabs; pn/el switch to pn.
  2. 15Führerbremsventil to Running; ease the direct brake until the C-pressure is below 0.5 bar. Right throttle
  3. 16Parking brake light stays lit; wait for the main reservoir (red needle) to reach 10 bar.
  4. 17pn test: brake pipe down to 4.2 bar, C-pressure rises on both bogies; release. Right throttle
  5. 18pn/el switch to el and repeat the 4.2 bar application and release. Right throttle
  6. 19desk Direct brake to 2 bar C-pressure, release, then apply it again to hold the loco.

Safety systems and tests

  1. 20SiFa and PZB to normal (LZB / INDUSI buttons on the ZDE panel). LZB stays isolated only light or under four braked coaches. Left aux Right aux
  2. 21For the PZB/LZB test: Forward, brake key unlocked, train brake released, direct brake on. Speedbrake lever
  3. 22MFA Press Prüftaste/Stör: lamps and sounds, two emergency applications, LZB calibration; then Prüftaste Lampen.
  4. 23SiFa pedal SiFa test: hold the pedal (Q): light at 30 s, 'SIFA' 2.5 s later, Zwangsbremsung 2.5 s after that.
  5. 24Test the horn. Right throttle button
  6. 25brake key in the cab Brake test: brake pipe 5 bar, brake key locked 60 s, it may drop 0.3 bar at most; unlock.
  7. 26Brake to 4.2 bar; with a cab car lock the brake key 10 s, the pipe must not rise. Right throttle
  8. 27outside Walk the train: every coach braked, then released. A sticking coach: overcharge to 5.3–5.5 bar.
  9. 28cab car With a cab car: hold Continuity Test until the main reservoir drops below 5 bar; it must climb to 8.

Train data (ZDE)

  1. 29ZDE panel BRA: 9 for passenger; 2 freight in G, 4 freight in P.
  2. 30EBuLa Brh: EBuLa [0], [9] SD, [2] Brh berechnen; enter braked weight and mass, [E].
  3. 31back wall sheet Convert it with the ZDE sheet (Brh im Zug) to the BRH to enter; a typical IC is 180, entered as 18.
  4. 32ZL: length in tens of metres, rounded up (254 m = 26). VMZ: lowest limit in tens (200 km/h = 20).
  5. 33ZDE panel Set BRA, BRH, ZL, VMZ, press ZD. [55] and [Stör] flashing = base data (Grunddaten) still active.
  6. 34Check: hold PZB Wachsam and PZB Frei together; the MFA shows the data. ENG 1 + ENG 2
  7. 35left screen Enter the train number and set up the GSM-R radio.

Departure, and leaving the cab

  1. 36Richtungsschalter to Forward; hold the ZS (train supply) switch at Start until 'ZS Aus' goes out. Speedbrake lever
  2. 37Release the doors on the platform side; after 'Schließvorgang eingeleitet' and Zp 9, back to Lock All. RUD TRIM
  3. 38back wall Parking brake off: with 1.5 bar or more C-pressure press the right (release) button.
  4. 39Führerbremsventil to Running, release the direct brake (keep it on until power on a gradient). Right throttle
  5. 40Fahrschalter through Min upwards; or AFB on ('AFB' three times), Fahrschalter to 0 once, set the speed. Left throttle Flap lever
  6. 41On the move: SiFa reset, PZB Wachsam, Frei, Befehl 40. Gear lever ENG 2 ENG 1 Round aux
  7. 42Leaving: full service, parking brake on (left button), brake key locked, reverser Off and out. Speedbrake lever PARK BRK

If it will not move

  • Reverser stuck: keep PARK BRK up (the reverser key is held only while it is) and the Fahrschalter at Off ('Z-Steller nicht in Null').
  • No pantograph or Hauptschalter: the auxiliary reservoir needs 3.5 bar for the pantograph, 7 bar for the HS (LSS 34F05, or drain below 4.8 bar).
  • PARK BRK moves both keys. For the brake-key leak tests, lock the brake key in the cab with the mouse so the reverser key stays in.
  • AFB will not take: brake on el with the HSM breaker set, train data entered, brake key unlocked, Forward, Fahrschalter back to 0 once.
  • SiFa / PZB dead: open their cut-off valves and set LSS 44F01 first; the aux squares only switch the isolation buttons.
